review_locator: PMID:29047262, Current Understanding of RANK Signaling in Osteoclast Differentiation and Maturation; PMID:33840674, RANKL-RANK signaling review
primary_title: RANK-mediated amplification of TRAF6 signaling leads to NFATc1 induction during osteoclastogenesis
decision_basis: The reviews identify TRAF6 as a principal cytoplasmic adaptor recruited by the RANK cytoplasmic tail; the cited primary study demonstrates RANK-mediated TRAF6 signaling and NFATc1 induction during osteoclastogenesis.
limitations_preserved: Cytoplasmic adaptor edge downstream of RANK; osteoclast-lineage model; does not establish ligand occupancy, autonomous RANK signaling in SCI, or terminal-TF transfer.

review_locator: PMID:36629496, Therapeutic targeting of TRAIL death receptors; PMCID:PMC7140660, TRAIL death-receptor signaling review
primary_title: TRAIL death-receptor signaling and FADD recruitment studies
decision_basis: The reviews identify FADD recruitment to TRAIL death receptors as the death-inducing signaling-complex adaptor step; the cited primary studies support TRAIL-stimulated DR4/FADD recruitment with downstream death-receptor signaling.
limitations_preserved: Ligand-stimulated DISC adaptor recruitment, not constitutive receptor binding; death-receptor/epithelial-cell context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMID:36629496, Therapeutic targeting of TRAIL death receptors; PMCID:PMC7140660, TRAIL death-receptor signaling review
primary_title: TRAIL death-receptor signaling and FADD recruitment studies
decision_basis: The reviews identify FADD recruitment to TRAIL death receptors as the death-inducing signaling-complex adaptor step; the cited primary studies support TRAIL-stimulated DR5/FADD recruitment and FADD-dependent death-receptor signaling.
limitations_preserved: Ligand-stimulated DISC adaptor recruitment, not constitutive receptor binding; DR5/death-receptor context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3781945, Structural Basis of Signal Transduction in the TNF Receptor Superfamily; PMCID:PMC4558505, Death receptor signaling review
primary_title: Structure of the Fas/FADD complex: a conditional death domain complex mediating signaling by receptor clustering
decision_basis: The reviews identify clustered Fas death-domain engagement of FADD as the conditional DISC assembly step; the cited primary study structurally and biophysically characterizes the clustered Fas/FADD death-domain complex.
limitations_preserved: Receptor clustering and open Fas death-domain conformation are required; this is a cytoplasmic adaptor/DISC edge, not Fas ligand binding or a universal downstream apoptosis claim.

review_locator: PMID:38020877, Fn14 and TNFR2 as regulators of inflammation and cell death; PMCID:PMC3799590, The TWEAK-Fn14 system as a potential drug target
primary_title: TWEAK-FN14 signaling induces lysosomal degradation of a cIAP1-TRAF2 complex to sensitize tumor cells to TNFalpha
decision_basis: The reviews identify ligand-stimulated Fn14 recruitment of TRAF2-cIAP1/2 as a receptor-adaptor complex step; the cited primary study demonstrates TWEAK/Fn14 recruitment and lysosomal degradation of the cIAP1-TRAF2 complex.
limitations_preserved: Receptor-ligated adaptor-complex assembly; cIAP1/2 are recruited through TRAF2 rather than direct Fn14 binding; tumor/MEF context and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
